ext.description: Use 9Router (and any OpenAI-compatible gateway) models in GitHub Copilot Chat: agent mode, tool calling, thinking, vision proxy, status bar, and automatic fallbacks.
cfg.serverUrl: Inference server URL (OpenAI API compatible endpoint)
cfg.apiKey: Deprecated. Use the 'Manage Providers' command to store the API key in VS Code's secret storage. Any value entered here is migrated and cleared on extension activation.
cfg.defaultMaxTokens: Fallback context window size (input tokens) when the server does not report it
cfg.defaultMaxOutputTokens: Fallback maximum output tokens when the server does not report context size
cfg.enableImageInput: Enable image input capability for models that support multimodal requests
cfg.visionProxyEnabled: Experimental. For models the server explicitly reports as non-vision, describe attached images with a vision-capable model (extra request; may use a paid model) and send the description as text. Has no effect when the server does not report vision support for a model
cfg.visionProxyModel: Model id used to describe images for the vision proxy (e.g. gc/gemini-2.5-flash). Empty = auto-pick a vision-capable model from the server list
cfg.encodeSlashInModelId: Expose '/' in gateway model ids as '::' in the model picker (e.g. xai/grok-4.5 -> xai::grok-4.5). Enable only if ids with '/' collide with other providers or break picker search. Changing it resets saved model selections; the gateway still receives the original id
cfg.modelFilter: Only list models whose id matches this regex (or substring if the regex is invalid), e.g. ^(cc|gh)/ . Empty = all models. A filter that matches nothing is ignored
cfg.enableToolCalling: Enable tool calling capability for models
cfg.parallelToolCalling: Allow model to call multiple tools in parallel (disable if model has issues with parallel calls)
cfg.agentTemperature: Fallback temperature for agent/tool calling mode (lower = more consistent tool call formatting). Set to 0.0 for best results with fine-tuned models. A temperature discovered from the backend's own model config (e.g. an Ollama Modelfile via /api/show) takes precedence; use perModelOptions to force a specific value.
cfg.verboseLogging: When enabled, the full chat request body (including messages and tool args) is written to the output channel. Keep disabled unless you are reproducing an issue — captured logs may contain conversation content from the user's current editor.
cfg.customHeaders: Deprecated. Use the 'Edit Custom Headers' command to store headers in VS Code's secret storage. Any value entered here is migrated and cleared on extension activation.
cfg.extraModelOptions: Extra parameters merged into the chat-completions request body (e.g. top_k, repetition_penalty, seed). Per-request modelOptions from the caller take precedence. Edit in settings.json for non-string values.
cfg.perModelOptions: Per-model chat-completion parameters, keyed by model id. Merged on top of 'extraModelOptions' for matching models; per-request modelOptions from the caller still take precedence. Keys match the model id exactly, or use a '*' wildcard for a whole family (case-insensitive, e.g. 'qwen*'). Exact-id entries win over wildcard entries. Example: { "qwen*": { "temperature": 0.7, "top_p": 0.8 }, "deepseek-r1": { "temperature": 0.6 } }. Edit in settings.json.
cfg.inlineCompletionProvider: Provider profile ID to route inline completions to. Leave blank to use the first enabled provider profile.
cfg.inlineCompletionModel: Model id to use for inline completions. Leave blank to use the first model reported by the server. Tip: point this at a small fill-in-the-middle / base model (e.g. a *-base or code FIM model) rather than a chat model for faster, cleaner completions.
cfg.inlineCompletionMaxTokens: Maximum tokens generated per inline completion. Lower values are faster and cheaper.
cfg.inlineCompletionDebounce: Milliseconds to wait after the last keystroke before requesting an inline completion. Higher values reduce load on the inference server while typing.
cfg.inlineCompletionTimeout: Per-request timeout (milliseconds) for inline completions. Kept short so a slow server doesn't block ghost-text suggestions.
cfg.inlineCompletionMaxPrefixChars: Maximum characters of context before the cursor to send for inline completions. Lower values reduce latency but provide less context.
cfg.inlineCompletionMaxSuffixChars: Maximum characters of context after the cursor to send for inline completions. Lower values reduce latency but provide less context.
cfg.statusBar: Show the 9Router connection indicator in the status bar.
cfg.healthCheckIntervalSeconds: How often (seconds) the status bar probes the gateway. Set high to reduce traffic.
cfg.dashboardOpen: Where the 9Router dashboard opens: your browser, or a VS Code editor tab (needs a gateway that allows framing).
cfg.dashboardUrl: Dashboard URL. Empty = the server root of the default profile (URL without /v1).
cfg.debugMode: Request debugging. off = none; metadata = log sizes/roles only; verbose = write full request dumps (API key always redacted) to the extension storage folder.
